evidence.quote: The utility has decided to re-tender the 35 MW/140 MWh Melkhout project, in the Eastern Cape, as well as the 1.54 MW/6.16 MWh Rietfontein project in the Northern Cape, which will include 2 MW of solar photovoltaic capacity.
